## Description

Employs Domain-Adversarial Neural Networks (DANN) with gradient reversal layers to learn domain-invariant alpha features that transfer robustly across different international stock exchanges.

## Where it may fit

Expanding quantitative strategies across emerging and developed markets, international equity rotation.

## Vehicles

Systematic Global Equity Funds, Multi-Market Quantitative Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Multi-country fundamental and technical feature panels, cross-sectional return labels.

## Caveats

Domain classifier penalty weight requires careful scheduling during backpropagation training.
